a.lede: The Raspberry Pi 16GB has gone up in price by $80 to $385. It now costs more than triple its January 2025 launch price.
a.title: 16GB Raspberry Pi 5 hiked to $385, more than triple its launch price

b.lede: Memory crunch pushes 16GB Pi 5 to $385, more than triple its launch price, just a month after the last round of hikes
b.title: Raspberry Pi hikes prices again, barely a month after the last round
